Full summary: Task 5 (/api/graph/neighborhood) review returned Needs Fixes: Critical depth-2 overflow entries omit the type field, violating the {from,type,omitted} contract the ego-explorer chips render from. Fix dispatched to the implementer (per-type grouping at the cut point + mixed-type test); re-review then commit.
Decisions: Accepted reviewer-flagged behavior as-is: depth-1 nodes never visited by the depth-2 walk emit no overflow entry — defensible reading of 'cut', pinned by tests; revisit only if Task 13's ego UI needs an exhaustive-cut signal.; Core neighborhood algorithm confirmed correct by reviewer hand-trace of both fixtures — round-robin, budgeted depth-2 walk, induced-subgraph relations, determinism all match the normative spec.
Findings: Implementer report headline claimed 30 new tests; diff contains 8 new it() blocks — copy/paste artifact in the report, corrected in ledger. Reminder: reports are unverified claims; the review layer caught it.
